proposed_facts.reason: Canonical lines 129–164 establish a callback installed at entrance completion that remains idle while cur_menu equals 0x21 and hands off to exit on departure. ActiveMenuProc meaningfully distinguishes this lifecycle role from input and entrance processing; rendered Think is not used as proof.

Canonical lines 141–164 and 185–200 establish the initially installed entrance-animation process, its exact end-frame equality test, and its interrupted-entry branch directly to exit. EnterAnimProc fits both the implementation and the functionality document without excluding the exceptional branch.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of the descriptor-size claim: four resource destinations and the StaticModelDesc declaration are supported, but they do not establish an exact 16-byte compiled section payload.
Accept deferral of .data string ownership. Source establishes animation settings, frame values and resource strings, not their emitted section membership.
Accept deferral of the exact small-data payload claim. The file-static visual GObj pointer is explicit, but source declarations do not establish compiled section placement or exclusivity.
Accept deferral of the 32-byte constant-pool and alignment claims. The text helper confirms the literals, but neither deduplication nor emitted pool size follows from these expressions.

Accept superseding Think with ActiveMenuProc. Think is not behaviorally false, but the proposed name materially clarifies the post-entrance departure-watcher role. Supported existing behavioral knowledge and the other established names remain retained.

Accept deferral of the .data link explanation: frame and text tables both participate in presentation, but source does not resolve the claimed section ownership of the text lookup array or its tension with the baseline .sdata attribution.

unresolved: Compiled section membership, exclusivity, descriptor byte size, constant-pool layout and alignment remain unverified; acceptance does not certify these inherited claims.

Accept the inherited cross-file lifetime deferral: safe teardown of the separate input GObj relative to departing visual state and released text depends on surrounding orchestration. No defect is established by this file.
